titulo: Moving to a New City Alone? "Becoming a Stranger Makes You Even Stranger"
caption:
Moving to a New City Alone? "Becoming a Stranger Makes You Even Stranger"

"Becoming a stranger makes you even stranger." Adam Mastroianni wrote it about leaving home, and Americans are doing it less.

Since the mid-1980s Americans have been less and less likely to move, he writes, mostly driven by the young. Our line: a new street shows you the rules you followed at home without seeing them, and then you get to pick which ones to keep. Go somewhere you are the stranger, even for one afternoon.

Source: "The Decline of Deviance" by Adam Mastroianni, Experimental History, 28 Oct 2025. Link: https://www.experimental-history.com/p/the-decline-of-deviance . Footage: Pixabay, Coverr, Unsplash. The retelling, and the lines said to you, are ours.

More strategies: link in bio.

descripcion:
Moving to a new city alone? "Becoming a stranger makes you even stranger," Adam Mastroianni writes about leaving home, in his essay The Decline of Deviance.
Americans have been less and less likely to move since the mid-1980s, he writes, mostly driven by the young. He says leaving takes a bit of a misfit.

Our line: a new street shows you the rules you followed at home without seeing them.
Our suggestion: stay a stranger for one afternoon, somewhere nobody knows you.
